notes: Both articles governing possessed nouns (τοῖς, ταῖς) are unrepresented under rule 20, the genitive pronouns αὐτοῦ and αὐτῶν being free to carry the possessives.
The articular infinitive's τοῦ is unrepresented under rule 61, no preposition governing it, so the bare 'to' is the infinitive's own helper.
κηρύσσειν takes a bare 'preach', the ASV not repeating the infinitival marker.
